summary: NLP Cloud automatically grants a $15 free credit on the pay-as-you-go plan — per the site's own FAQ that plan requires a credit card, so the credit subsidizes a PAYG start rather than being a card-free grant. Separately, a $0 Free plan needs no card and covers pretrained models at 2 parallel requests with limited throughput. Indexed official terms say this separate Free plan must only be used for development/testing, never production, and permit only one Free plan per application or website and per IP address. Those Free-plan restrictions are not being attributed to the PAYG credit. Direct pricing and terms access returned 403 during this recheck; official indexed excerpts support the qualification, but the current full terms were not verified. Pay-as-you-go has no fixed cost: CPU requests $0.003, GPU $0.005, plus per-token/second surcharges on generative models.
claim_steps: For the $15 credit: activate the pay-as-you-go plan — the site FAQ states a credit card is needed for this plan; the $15 credit applies automatically.
Card-free option: choose the separate $0 Free plan — pretrained models only, 2 parallel requests, limited throughput.

For the separate Free plan, indexed official terms prohibit production and limit it to one Free plan per application/website and per IP. Direct terms access was blocked; review the full terms yourself before relying on this option.
